searchText: Names are very sticky. What about naming it `Shard Blob Transactions` instead? The naming issue is down to the hard fork in which EIP-4844 will land. It will either be `capella` or whatever hard fork comes after. Personally I'd be inclined to pick a star starting with D and put it there for now, we can always bring it back in if EIP-4844 will make it in to capella. Deneb is relatively easy to both speak and type, so that would be my preference. You have my vote for Deneb 🦢 I had mooted that we call it deneb before, that'd be my preference... maybe i'll bring it up again
